name: kanto-labs-mcp
description: Web data, SEO, domain authority, traffic rank, company enrichment, topic trends, OCR, documents and images via Kanto Labs' Apify actors.
long_description: 14 tools backed by Kanto Labs' pay-per-event actors on Apify. detect_website_tech_stack ($0.003 per website): Detect the technologies a website runs on: CMS, ecommerce, frameworks, analytics, CDN, hosting (7,600+ fingerprints). convert_document_to_markdown ($0.004 per document): Convert PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, EPUB, HTML and more from a URL to Markdown, with page/word counts and optional RAG chunks. audit_website_seo ($0.004 per page): On-page SEO audit: 0-100 score and prioritized issues, robots.txt, sitemap, llms.txt and AI-crawler checks, optional broken links and crawl. extract_text_from_image ($0.003 per image or PDF page ($0.008 with quality "accurate")): OCR text from images, screenshots, photos and scanned PDFs, in reading order with confidence and optional line boxes. lookup_domain ($0.003 per domain): Domain RDAP/WHOIS, DNS records, SSL certificate expiry and SPF/DKIM/DMARC email security grade. extract_video_frames ($0.002 per frame): Extract scene-change or evenly spaced frames from video files, with public image links, timestamps and a free contact sheet. download_images ($0.002 per image): Download every image from web pages or image links, de-duplicated and filtered, with public download URLs. check_domain_authority ($0.001 per domain scored (unranked domains free)): 0-100 domain authority from the open Common Crawl web graph (133M domains): web rank, PageRank rank, top-% percentile and monthly trend. enrich_company ($0.003 per company enriched, coming soon): Company profile from a domain or name: logo, description, social profiles, app links and key pages, plus industry, HQ, founding year, employees, revenue and ticker from Wikidata. upscale_image ($0.01 per image ($0.06 per large image with allowLargeImages), coming soon): Upscale images 2x or 4x with Real-ESRGAN (photo or anime model), transparency kept, with public download links. get_topic_trends ($0.003 per topic, coming soon): Interest over time for topics on a shared 0-100 scale (a Google Trends alternative) from official Wikipedia pageviews since 2015: peak, trend, spikes and interest by language. get_trending_topics ($0.0005 per trending article, coming soon): The most-read topics of a day per country or Wikipedia language edition, with views and a one-line description. check_website_traffic_rank ($0.002 per domain ranked (unranked domains free), coming soon): Website popularity from real Chrome user data (CrUX): global rank tier, tier in 40 countries, top countries and monthly trend, plus Majestic rank and referring subnets. search_free_images ($0.001 per image, coming soon): Search freely licensed images on Wikimedia Commons, with license, author and a ready-to-paste attribution line; filter by license, size, orientation and format. Runs are billed to your own Apify account; failures are free and every call has a spending cap. Tools marked coming soon call actors that are not public on the Apify Store yet; until they are, they return a clear error and nothing is charged.
